messages:
Alex: Quick sync — noticed a blindspot: when a hosted request falls back to private due to capacity, our observability traces don't include the original tenant tag. It makes debugging SLO regressions painful.
Maria: ugh, yeah. Seen it on the billing dashboard. We get a new trace id from the private sidecar and the cost attribution flips.
Dan: Is this the same flow where the control plane rewrites the request and injects a temporary token? If so, we never propagate the original x-tenant header into the fallback path.
Sophia: Correct. Fallback does a short-lived reissue: `X-Tenant-Proxy: <ephemeral>` and we intentionally scrub the original `Authorization` for safety. But we should copy metadata tags for observability, not credentials.
Alex: Proposal: split "credential handoff" vs "metadata propagation". Credential handoff must rotate; metadata (tenant_id, route_hint, cost_center) can be forwarded with signature. Thoughts?
Noah: Agree. We can sign a metadata blob with the control plane key: `meta.sig=v1(<tenant_id>|<ts>)` so receiving runtime can trust it's from CP.
Maria: That sounds good but who owns verifying the signature? Hosted runtime, dedicated pool, or the private sidecar? We need a clear ownership map.
Dan: Operationally, verification should be in the ingress/runtime shim that accepts handed-off requests. That keeps application code clean. So runtime teams own verification.
Sophia: Edge case: air-gapped private installs that don't share CP keys. For those, we need a "local trust" toggle and an audit-only fallback where we accept metadata but mark it untrusted in traces.
Alex: Right. So: (1) runtime verifies meta.sig when shared keys exist, (2) if no shared key, runtime marks traces as `meta.trust:unverified` and emits an audit event to ops.
Infra-Bot: Deploy note: will add feature flag `propagate_metadata.trust_mode` to manifests. Default: `strict` for hosted/dedicated, `audit` for isolated-private.
Noah: Also: tweak sampling — if fallback happened, ensure we keep 100% sampling of that request for 60s so we can correlate. Otherwise we lose the chain.
Maria: Cost attribution: on fallback we should keep token cost attribution pinned to original tenant until the finish of request. Important for billing accuracy.
Dan: Implementation sketch:
```
# control plane hands off
X-Orig-Tenant: tenant-123
X-Meta-Sig: v1:BASE64(sig)
X-Fallback-Reason: capacity
```
On runtime: verify X-Meta-Sig -> attach tags to trace -> continue.
```
Sophia: I'll draft an RFC for the meta signature schema and verification hook. Also adding an observability dashboard card showing `fallback_count` by tenant.
Alex: Awesome. Can we get owners assigned? Sophia -> RFC + dashboard. Dan -> runtime verification lib. Maria -> billing contract (attribution). Noah -> sampling hook. I'll coordinate rollout plan and a canary.
Maria: +1. Timeline request: can we aim for alpha in 3 weeks? That's tight but feasible.
Sophia: I'll try. If we hit air-gapped key exchange issues, we may need an extra week.
Alex: ok. Thanks everyone. Will ping once RFC draft is up.
Infra-Bot: Created ticket INF-8792 for `propagate_metadata` flag and linked to this thread.
